title: Auditory effects

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Auditory effects are defined as any subjective effect which directly alters a person's sense of hearing. 

This page lists and describes the various auditory effects which can occur under the influence of certain psychoactive compounds.

Auditory acuity enhancement

Auditory acuity suppression

Auditory distortion

Auditory hallucination

Temporal scaling

See also

*Subjective effect index
*Visual effects

References
